relevance.rationale: A 42-page survey of twisted Alexander polynomials of 3-manifolds: definition via twisted Reidemeister torsion tau(N, gamma tensor psi) for gamma: pi_1(N) -> GL(k,R), Poincare duality, distinguishing knots and links, concordance and doubly-slice obstructions, lower bounds on knot genus and the Thurston norm, fiberedness obstructions, and higher-order Alexander polynomials. Checked against the corpus: (i) the folio's only Alexander-polynomial use is the *untwisted* torus-link polynomial Delta_{T(2,2m)}(t) = (t^m - t^{-m})/(t - t^{-1}) evaluated at t = q in ex:threading-link-alexander, which needs nothing from a twisted theory; (ii) the torsion the folio does need -- the adjoint Reidemeister torsion appearing in the 1-loop = torsion route -- is already cited at the specific-result level via garoufalidis-yoon-2024, ohtsuki-takata2015 and dimofte-garoufalidis; (iii) 'Thurston norm', 'fiberedness' and 'fibered knot', the survey's principal applications, do not occur anywhere in content/*.md. A survey contributes no theorem the folio can consume that its existing specific citations do not already supply. Scope-(a) negative: this document, as read, supplies nothing usable here -- not a claim that twisted invariants are irrelevant to the framework in principle.

proposedActions.rationale: The one place the corpus touches Alexander polynomials (ex:threading-link-alexander) uses the untwisted torus-link formula; the adjoint-torsion results the folio actually leans on are cited from their primary sources. Adding this survey would create a bib orphan.
